In this section, a more general gradient method is presented. It is assumed that the

Moreover, the solution space must have an interior. This rules out both implicit and

The SUMT (Sequential Unconstrained Maximization Technique) algorithm 
is based on transforming the constrained problem into an equivalent unconstrained 
problem. The procedure is more or less similar to the Lagrange multipliers method. 
The transformed problem can then be solved using the steepest-ascent method
